perks.name: Ionic Overclock
perks.description: While amplified, your Fusion Rifles, Linear Fusion Rifles, and Heat weapons gain increased handling, reload, and vent speeds.
perks.exact:
While Amplified:
(Linear) Fusion Rifles and Heat Weapons are granted +? Handling and +? Reload Speed.

perks.name: Shock and Clear
perks.description: Final blows with Jolt or against jolted combatants create Ionic Traces.
perks.exact:
Upon scoring a Jolt Kill or a Jolted Enemy Kill:
Creates an Ionic Trace.

item.name: Reaper
item.description: Shortly after using your class ability, your next weapon final blow spawns an Orb of Power.
item.exact:
On Class Ability Usage:
The next Weapon Kill within 10 seconds spawns an Orb of Power.

Orb of Power:
0.8% | 1.1% | 1.25% | 1.5% Super Energy.

Incurs a 10 | 5 | 1 second cooldown between Orbs.

item.name: Distribution
item.description: Reduces all ability cooldowns when using your class ability near targets.
item.exact:
On Class Ability Usage while within 15 metres of an enemy:
Grants Grenade, Melee, Class, and Super Energy.

4% | 6% | 7% Grenade, Melee and Class Energy
2% | 3% | 4% Super Energy

2% | 3% | 3.5% Grenade, Melee and Class Energy
1% | 1.5% | 2% Super Energy
